source_note: 一个递推序列的渐近问题
callout_id: 一个递推序列的渐近问题#1
english_title: Problem 0: Fudan University 2024 Graduate Entrance Examination Problem
statement_en: Let $a_1=2024$, and suppose that for every positive integer $n$ the sequence satisfies the recurrence relation $$a_{n+1}=a_n+\frac{2}{a_n}.$$ Find $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{n}}.$$
callout_body: $a_1=2024$,并且对任意正整数n序列满足递推关系$$a_{n+1}=a_{n}+\frac{2}{a_n}$$求$$\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{n}}$$
